description: Stock provisoire de canal is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaamse Milieu Maatschappij. In production. Coverage: Vlaamse Milieu Maatschappij. The portal shows the English title as "Provisional Canal Stock" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vlaamse Milieu Maatschappij. Its keywords include DEPARTEMENT LIN - AMINAL - AFDELING, VMM, GRACHTENBESTAND, AMINAL - AFDELING WATER, LIN - AMINAL - AFDELING. The listing shows 1998-05-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
